ops.sql: SELECT g.GroupName FROM t_secgroup g INNER JOIN t_secusergroup ug ON ug.GroupID = g.GroupID INNER JOIN t_secuser u ON u.UserID = ug.UserID WHERE u.UserLogin = '<LOGIN>' ORDER BY g.GroupName

SELECT TOP 5 u.UserLogin FROM t_secuser u INNER JOIN t_secusergroup ug ON ug.UserID = u.UserID INNER JOIN t_secgroup g ON g.GroupID = ug.GroupID WHERE g.GroupName = '<WRITE-GROUP>' ORDER BY u.UserLogin
